verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions 'prompt engineering' only in passing, as a self-hosted capability with a link to a prompt hub, and describes a Playground that forwards requests to LLM APIs. Nothing documents prompt versioning, commits or tags, or pushing prompt changes to production without a code deploy. Prompt management is a fair axis for an LLM observability and evaluation platform, so absent evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code
